[[Kaanai Canyon (Luxon)|Kaanai Canyon]] is one of five outposts used for entering [[Alliance Battles]] from the Luxon side.

==Getting there==
Speak to a [[Luxon Navigator]] at a Luxon [[guild hall]] when the [[Kurzick-Luxon border]] is in deep [[Luxon]] territory.
